official: 学校教育職員の給与に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案

name: 副校長などの給料表と手当の扱いを変更
summary: 現在の条例では、学校教育職員の給料表や管理職員特別勤務手当の支給条件などを定めています。この議案は、統括副校長・副校長の給料表と手当の対象時間などを見直し、主務教諭を規定に加えます。
changes: 統括副校長・副校長に適用する給料表を改める
管理職員特別勤務手当の対象時間と算定方法を見直す
主務教諭を職として加え、給料表の職名を主任教諭から主務教諭に改める
who: 品川区の学校教育職員
why: 特別区人事委員会勧告等を踏まえて給料表や手当を見直し、学校教育法の改正で主務教諭が設けられることに対応するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises pay scales and allowances for vice-principals and other staff
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Salaries of School Education Personnel
en.summary: The current ordinance sets out pay scales for school education personnel and conditions for paying the special work allowance for management staff, among other things. This bill revises the pay scales for supervising vice-principals and vice-principals, the hours eligible for the allowance, and other matters. It also adds chief teachers to the provisions.
changes: Revises the pay scale for supervising vice-principals and vice-principals
Reviews the eligible hours and calculation method for the special work allowance for management staff
Adds chief teachers as a job category and changes the job title on the pay scale from senior teacher to chief teacher
who: School education personnel in Shinagawa City
en.why: The city says it is reviewing pay scales and allowances in light of recommendations, among other things, from the Special Ward Personnel Commission, and responding to the establishment of chief teachers through the revision of the School Education Act.
